title: KALAHI: A handcrafted, grassroots cultural LLM evaluation suite for Filipino

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to culturally specific, situationally-enriched prompts using both multiple-choice selection tasks (identifying the most culturally appropriate action) and open-ended generation, which is assessed via automated metrics and human evaluation for cultural actionability, sensitivity, and relevance to Filipino norms.

Assessing the performance of large language models on prompts written in Filipino (Manila Educated Tagalog) to highlight and measure the disparity in model capabilities and grammatical/spelling proficiency between high-resource languages (like English) and lower-resource languages.
